_note: Configuration for the WORDLIB creative layer (Godot + OpenClaw). All paths are relative to USB root and resolved at runtime. Edit model tags only if you have pulled different ones in Ollama.

godot._comment: Godot AI plugins (e.g. AI Assistant Hub) connect to Ollama at 127.0.0.1:11434 and should be set to use the ai_assist_model tag above.

code._comment: Default. Deterministic, clean code output. Best for GDScript and general coding.

heavy_code._comment: Very deterministic. For long refactors and multi-file changes.

creative._comment: Uncensored, more personality. For brainstorming and writing.

openclaw._comment: OpenClaw is the Ollama agent profile. work_dir is where it reads/writes files by default.

models_to_pull._note: Pulled by Setup scripts. Reference list of exact Ollama tags.
